description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android TextView used for outputting log data received via the LogNode interface. It formats log entries and displays them in an Android app's UI, supporting chainable logging nodes.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView subclass implementing LogNode for displaying log messages with formatting and thread safety, including chainability with other LogNode instances.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats a log message with priority, tag, message, and exception info, then appends it to the LogView UI component. Also forwards the log to the next LogNode if configured.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append strings with a delimiter if the string is not null or empty.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the LogView display.
